task_metadata.research_topic: observational causal discovery for linear Gaussian SEMs with CPDAG recovery
task_metadata.research_question: Design a causal discovery algorithm that recovers the Markov equivalence class, represented as a CPDAG, from purely observational linear Gaussian data.
notes: The task evaluates CPDAG recovery on synthetic Erdos-Renyi and scale-free graphs under linear Gaussian SEM assumptions.

The repo baseline stub names Chickering 2002 for GES, but exact BibTeX retrieval for that paper failed in MCP during this run; the GES baseline is therefore linked to concrete GES-focused follow-on papers with status paper_linked_approx.

tests.label: ER10
tests.notes: ER synthetic graph family plus CPDAG/Markov equivalence target.

tests.label: ER20
tests.notes: Larger Erdos-Renyi synthetic graph with CPDAG recovery target.

tests.label: SF50
tests.notes: Scale-free synthetic graph family plus CPDAG/Markov equivalence target.

tests.label: SF50-Hard
tests.notes: Denser scale-free synthetic graph with the same CPDAG target.

tests.label: ER20-Noisy
tests.notes: Noisier Erdos-Renyi evaluation scenario with the same CPDAG recovery objective.
